Version 1.8.6

Hotfix for Mechanic issue Let me know if it still throws an error.

THIS WORKS FOR 2.3.0 AND 2.4.0 FOR SPT 4.0.13 AND 4.1.2

Version 1.8.5 Small fix and availability of AK ammo

Fixed stat issue on 7.62x39 PS Match

Added some Ref buys for AK ammo at 1 tier lower, but for extremely high prices. Should make some guns a little more enticing, but not change things drastically since.

Basically Ref is scalping some of Mechanics bullets and marking them up like a Costco water bottle at a football game.

AGAIN, THIS ADD-ON WORKS WITH BOTH 2.4.0 AND 2.3.0 FOR SPT 4.0.13 AND 4.1.2

Version 1.8.4

Total Spawning and Crafting Rework

Once again I must thank everybody for trying and supporting this ammo pack! We are almost at 750 downloads! If we can hit 1000 before the forge shuts down I would be blown away.

Thank you all, this has been fun. Keep submitting suggestions!

For this update I decided that the way some of the ammos were spawned and crafted were a bit odd. It also made it too easy or too hard to find certain ammos.

Additionally, some ammos had crafts, and some didn’t. Some that didn’t, were perplexing. Example would be the improved AK ammos. The only way to get them was through Mechanic. So what do you do with the AK ammo you find? Well now you can use them to craft the new ammos! Or you can sell them, or shoot them. Idk what you want to do with them, thats up to you. But now you can use them to craft the good good.

Minor fixes to certain ammos. Typos in descriptions.

  • Changed spawns of pretty much every ammo. Now many ammos spawn as ammo packs instead of loose rounds/shells in places you find them
  • High tier and super rare ammos can now only be found in a few short list of places. One of the most consistent is the Common Fund Stash AKA Shturmans stash.
  • Other ammos spawn in many other locations in different amounts. Some loose ammo, some in boxes. The more common the ammo, the more often its in a box. If its super rare, it’ll probably be loose.
  • Added many new crafts. The AK ammos especially all got added crafts. Go find some gunpowder!
  • Adjusted some other crafts to make more sense and change cost to craft a bit
  • Small adjustment to heat and durability for some ammunition. 3.5 shotgun shells were touched slightly. Slugs generate more heat than buckshot and birdshot. The TSS buckshot now degrades the durability the fastest

Added:

  • 5.56x45mm HEI - This 5.56 round is manufactured by Firequest and a few other small manufacturers. It is expensive, and hard to find. While its penetration is somewhat lacking compared to similarly priced ammo, the 3,000 degree High Energy Incendiary payload rapidly degrades armor. The intensity also causes confusion and a stun effect.

ALSO WORKS WITH AMMOGEN 2.3.0 FOR SPT 4.0.13

Version 1.8.3

Shotgun Heat, Durability, and armor damage Patch

After further testing by both myself and Dapal in the comments, further refinements have been made towards the topic of heat and durability of the 3.5 magnum shells. My last patch seems to have made the shells generate too little heat. This is a small step back to smoking barrels. We will find the perfect balance, and I really hope this is it.

Lastly, it was discovered that thanks to the increased pellet count of many of the new shells, armor was being degraded too quickly. I created a new formula to calculate number of shells (assuming a 100% pellet hit rate) to 0% out a piece of armor with 30 health. After making that formula, I found that most of the new shells had armor damage values ranging from a little strong, to literally zeroing an Ubey helmet in one hit.

Oops

This update completely fixes (tm) that mess. I have numbers to prove it!

Given the above, the following has changed:

  • 3.5 inch magnum shells have had some heat added back. Durability burn unchanged
  • ALL multiple projectile rounds and shells have had their armor damage reworked. Now it should take a reasonable number of hits to zero out armor pieces. Basically this should prevent the swiss-cheese-ification of armor and helmets when you shoot things with shotguns.
  • Some shell penetration values were balanced out to alleviate the same problem as above. Some were actually increased.
  • Also some minor changes to ammo spawn chances and locations. Many rare ammos can now be found in the loot pool inside of Shturman’s common fund stash. I wish more bosses had their own loot pool like that. But what can I say, go find the SVD maniac and take his stuff.

ALSO WORKS WITH 2.3.0 FOR SPT 4.0.13

Version 1.8.2 Heat and Durability Patch

After testing by both myself and Dapal in the comments, it appears I overtuned the heat and durability burn on the 3.5 inch magnum shells.

This caused fairly nominal shell counts to jam guns and roast handguards. That having been said, high heat and durability burn is intended for these shells. They fire extremely powerful payloads and are intended for pump action, double barrel, and the Benelli M3 only.

Thus, as part of a first attempt to get the numbers in line, durability burn has been decreased approximately 25-30% depending on the shell. Heat generation has been decreased approximately 30-40% depending on the shell.

Spamming the 3.5 inch shells is intended to overheat the guns quickly. The buckshot and birdshot shells generate less heat and wear, and thus have more tolerance for rapid fire. However the slugs and TSS buckshot are not intended for tube dumps. You can do it, but probably only once.

Please please please leave comments on the ongoing balance of these things. I’ve said it before. I am one person who can test one thing at a time. While I do release these updates after testing, I can only test a few ammos in a few setups per session. It is impossible to test every combination and especially every mod. I want to make these ammos compatible with as many mods as possible, so if you see an issue or conflict, tell me just like Dapal did. We are troubleshooting and I hope to figure out the issue.

ALSO WORKS WITH VERSION 2.3.0 FOR SPT 4.0.13

Version 1.8.1 Balancing Pass #6 and Some New Stuff

A lot of minor balance changes and one addition.

  • Reduced accuracy of buckshot slightly, might have overdone it on the last version. Doesn’t feel broken, but just appears to be a little too good a little too far.
  • Reduced damage of 3.5 inch .50 BMG slug from 231 to 221, this prevents killing in 3 shots to the arm, assuming a round doesn’t fragment and they haven’t taken any damage. Also reduced frag chance
  • Updated description of a few shells
  • Removed ability for 3.5 inch buckshot shells to fragment. That was a whoopsy. (it had a small chance though to be fair)
  • Increased fragmentation chance of AP-21 slightly
  • Reduced frag chance for steel buckshot and 00000 buckshot
  • Increased recoil of 7N49 by 5%, reduce damage by 1 point, now takes an extra shot to arms to kill
  • Reduced frag chance of AP GX to 20%, matching FMJ FX
  • Removed added bleed chance for SS190 X, matching rest of calibers lineup
  • SS90 bleed chance, frag chance, and armor damage all increased slightly. Its so rare that it needed a use case beyond it being cool. In real life it did tumble and fragment something fierce, so I’m trying to represent that here.
  • .50 AE Xtreme Penetrator heavy bleed chance increased
  • .45 ACP AP +P+ removed bleed chance to match rest of caliber, reduced damage 4 points to 60, should take an extra bullet to the legs and stomach to kill.
  • 7.62x25mm TT PBS reduced pen and damage, increased recoil, reduced accuracy. Now should not completely usurp the necked down cartridges and better serves a gap in the caliber without seeming too strong. Also increased heat buildup and durability burn.
  • 9x18mm PBP increased armor damage slightly, increased price dramatically
  • 9x39 Geksa increased price slightly
  • .366 AP-ME increased price
  • .50 BMG Frangible reduced price
  • PS12 Supersonic increased recoil
  • Moved M67RD to Mechanic

Added:

  • F-1 Impact - Need I say more? A Prapor special. So of course he added gunpowder to the cavity the old fuse left. This WILL kill you if you mess up the throw. Have fun. Can be crafted.

  • 12/70 3 1/2 Inch Magnum TSS AP 00 Buckshot - Invented by Mechanic after seeing the success of the 2 3/4 inch version. He created it by taking two of the TSS 00 shells and putting the now 12 pellets into the shell of 3 1/2 inch magnum buckshot shell. The result is a Tungsten Alloy 12 pellet shotgun shell aimed at defeating soft body armor. While slightly slower than the standard shell, mainly due to weight and pressure reasons, its larger pellet count makes it frightening. Extremely rare, extremely expensive, extremely effective. Can be crafted from other TSS shells, buckshot shells, more gunpowder, and a bunch of tools.

Version 1.8.0 The AK update

I want to start with a huge thank you to everyone. Yesterday was 250 downloads, today we are over 360! Thank you for enjoying this mod, I hope to keep going until I run out of ideas. On to the big AK update.

I’ve been toying with how to go about this for some time, but decided the easiest method would be to add a few ammos per AK caliber (5.45 and 7.62x39) that slightly reduce performance, but in turn have better accuracy and noticeably less recoil. While one of the biggest downsides of the AK platforms is rate of fire being pretty much across the board 600-700 rpm, another big downside is somewhat poor accuracy and wild recoil. While the accuracy is honestly pretty realistic, the recoil isn’t. 5.45 is even easier to control than 5.56, yet in game the gun bounces around like crazy.

So here we go, all of the below “Match” Rounds are, lore wise, remanufactured surplus by Mechanic. The bullets are pulled, the best are chosen, and then they are loaded with more accurate, reliable, consistent, but less powerful and less corrosive powders. The result is less velocity and penetration, but with better accuracy, less recoil, and less heat buildup and durability burn. They are more expensive of course, gotta pay for his labor, but they will certainly help the AKs be more viable late-game. Also, none of these can be found in raid as part of being “Mechanic made” rounds. Gotta get them all straight from the man himself.

7.62: + 20% accuracy, -20 % recoil, -2 dam, -2 pen, - 2 armor damage %, +40% price SP Match FMJ Match PS Match PP Match BP Match MAI AP Match

5.45: + 15% accuracy, -15% recoil, -3 dam, -1 pen, -3 armor damage %, +40% price SP Match FMJ Match PS Match BT Match 7N40 Match BP Match BS Match PPBS Match

Also added .45 ACP AP +P+ - This is a dangerous little thing to shoot, but packs a punch. Crazy high durability burn and heavy build up. Mechanic made this as a joke by adding 25% more powder into the .45 AP round. Surprisingly it functioned, for a few rounds. Intended for pistols as the heat and durability will trash anything automatic. Have fun! Seriously, this round will destroy your machine guns.

Again, thank you, let me know what you think and if you want me to add anything!

Version 1.7.5 Some requests and Other additions

Version 1.7.4 was just a small update where I added more detail into some ammo descriptions and slightly reduced the explosion power and fragment count of the APEx and Raufoss rounds. So I just decided to add it into this larger update.

Fixes and balancing: Increased accuracy of all buckshot rounds across the board. They were just a little too spread out at mid range. Long range they are still wide patterns. Increased accuracy of KS 23 lead slug, now has no bonus or detriment

Added: 9x39 Geska - Just like Mechanic took an SP-5 and made AP-M, Im making a flesh round for the 9x39 guns, cause it was needed. Its a .366 Geska round, made subsonic, and put into a 9x30 shell. Less damage than the .366, but more than any other 9x39. To me, this completes the caliber. Realistically the BP-Gs round in EFt already VASTLY outperforms its real life equivalent that I am not going to give it a more powerful round. I feel the same way about .300 blackout AP btw. Imo subsonic rounds shouldn’t have pen above 40, but bsg gave them 54 lol.

5.45x39mm Frangible - 5.45 didn’t really have a warmagedon equivalent, so I made one. I know the fire rates on the 5.45 guns don’t really make leg meta the go-to, but at least it is slightly more viable now. If only slightly.

7.62x39mm Frangible - Same as above, but bigger boolet.

Multiple projectile rifle cartridges: Funnily enough I was already planning on doing a duplex rebound in 7.62 NATO just like the actual SALVO trial submission. (M198) So when I got a request for some anti-drone rounds, I jumped at the idea.

I will be very honest, apart from the duplex M198 rounds, these all kinda suck lmao. These are made to shoot drones by shear volume of fire. Ukrainian reports indicate that when they use a similar ammo in their 5.45 guns, it takes multiple hits and shots to down a drone. Feel free to do a little research, on these ammos. It really is an ammunition developed out of desperation and lack of other options. But it is cool, so I made it. Thanks for the suggestion!

Added: 7.62x51mm Duplex M198 - This was a real ammo developed by the US military, and they made over 4 MILLION rounds of this stuff. It had two 84 grain shortened 7.62 rounds snuggled up to each other in the cartridge body. It fired at pretty much full velocity and fed and ran in all the guns pretty well. They quickly discovered that to increase hit probability, you can just use a smaller round (5.56) and shoot more of them. So they ended the SALVO program, and went with the M16/M4. In game, these are actually somewhat useable, albeit at close range only. Its damage per second is actually pretty damn good thanks to how video game logic works.

5.45x39mm Anti-Drone - These are essentially 5.45 “ratshot”. These use a thin metal casing that peels away after firing to launch 7 pellets of T-shot steel pellets. Intended purely to shoot down drones, I guess you could shoot other things? Good luck I guess. Reliability is suboptimal.

5.56x45mm Anti-Drone - The 5.56 version of the above. Except the slightly larger 5.56 allows TTT pellets, which are larger, but only 6 of them. Overall this is the more “powerful” of the two, but I wouldn’t bet your life on these. Reliability is suboptimal.

Version 1.7.3 3.5 inch magnum addition and Benelli buff!

Added: 12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum 000 Buckshot - This shell fires 12 000 buckshot pellets at 1250 fps. Each pellet is copper plated for added penetration and chance of fragmentation. Believe it or not this is my first actually fictional commercial shell. As far as I can tell, nobody makes a 3.5 inch 000 buck shell and sells it on a large scale. I do see loading stats and some forums where people hand load these. But the idea was too cool to pass up. HEAVY recoil, only surpassed by the 3.5 inch magnum slug.

Benelli M3 buff: I gave it the ability to fire the 3.5 inch magnum shells! Oh yeah. BSG made the benelli so forgettable, when in reality it should be the top dog of the non-mag fed shotguns. It fires too slow to really work. Well now, it can do work! The low rate of fire of the M3 actually helps when firing the 3.5 inch shells, as they have a LOT of recoil. Really like this change, but give feedback on your thoughts.

Also, with the recent news of SPT in its current form being closed down in 10 days, I will push as much as I can out. PLEASE give comments and thoughts. The responses thus far have been super helpful. Thank you all so much for 50 downloads on the last version, and over 250 total!

Version 1.7.2 New Incendiary Ammo and quick fix Fixed wrong Arena level for APIs

These new pure incendiaries have less damage and pen but have a small flashbang effect on impact and degrade armor very quickly.

Added: 7.62x51mm M1 Custom - The 7.62x51mm M1 Custom is a round made by Mechanic. After finding a stockpile of surplus 1940s M1 30.06 cartridges, he pulled the projectiles and loaded them into 7.62 NATO casings. The result is a pure Incendiary round with a minor stun effect to the recipient.

7.62x54mm R PZ3 - The 7.62x54mm R PZ3 is a Prapor remanufactured pure incendiary tracer round used many years ago by the Soviet and russian militaries.

Version 1.7.1 Balancing Pass #5

Reduced explosion size of new API ammos slightly, removed fragments from explosion.

Version 1.7.0 6.5 CBJ and APIs for 7.62 NATO and 7.62 R

The 6.5 CBJ is a super exciting and relatively new derivation of 9mm. The cartridge takes up the same dimensions as 9mm, but features a necked down casing, similar to .357 SIG, but from 9mm to 6.5mm. This enables much higher velocities, sometimes in excess of 900 mps (2950 fps) out of a 12 inch barrel. From an 8 inch barrel, velocities around 830 mps (2724 fps) are regular. From a pistol length barrel (4.5-5 inches) velocities remain high at around 730 m/s (2350 fps).

APDS - This cartridge is capable of frankly incredible armor penetration. Its “Core” cartridge is a 4mm pure tungsten penetrator surrounded by a 6.5mm sabot. It can penetrate 9mm of hardened steel armor. Watch the Forgotten Weapons video on it. Wild stuff from a pistol too!

HET - This particular cartridge is a 2.5 gram brass semi-armor piercing projectile. Its purpose is for law enforcement to have a poor ballistic coefficient, limiting its range and chance for third party injuries during shooting events. However, its penetration is still remarkable, able to penetrate a kevlar and titanium target and maintain 12 inches of soft target penetration. Its wound channel is also notable.

Subsonic - This particular cartridge is an 8 gram subsonic projectile with a tungsten penetrator core. The result is a subsonic cartridge that can still match the NATO CRISAT requirements, effectively penetrating level 3 (in Tarkov) armor while still penetrating over 12 inches in gel.

HP - This particular cartridge is a solid Copper expanding hollow point similar to many personal defense rounds on the market. However this round is screaming at over 2700 fps, making rapid and energetic expansion guaranteed. It still maintains incredible penetration for a pistol hollowpoint.

Frangible - This particular cartridge is a 2.5 gram copper-tin sinstered projectile. Aimed at use in training and high security areas like power plants and planes where damaging the surrounding equipment is costly and dangerous. This round disintegrates upon contact with a hard surface, but perform remarkably well with soft targets.

APIs: Armor piercing incendiary with a small explosive: 7.62x51mm M14A1 - This round was designed as an Armor Piercing Incendiary (API) round intended for the 7.62 NATO platforms. It features a 148 grain projectile with about 7-8 grains of incendiary powder in front of a steel penetrator.

The 7.62x54mm R ZBZ3 - This is a soviet and russian designed Armor Piercing Incendiary (API) round intended for the SVD/SVDS platforms. It features a 151 grain projectile with about 9-11 grains of incendiary powder in front of a steel penetrator.

Version 1.6.4 Balancing Pass #4 & new ammos:

Adjustments to purchase availability and crafting recipes/amounts - Frangible rounds given more ammo per trader reset - low-mid tier rounds given more per reset - Buckshot and birdshot rounds given more per reset - grenade crafts changed to need 3 input grenades but also output 3. Less tedious to make now. - Arena ammo price in crease with Ref, reduced price with Lightkeeper. - Reduced most grenade costs, changed background color.

  • Slightly increased fuse time on M67RD

Added: 12.7x55mm PS12 Supersonic - This is a standard PS12 round with added gunpowder. This means this round is no longer subsonic, and is therefore much louder, however its penetration increases substantially.

.338 Lapua Magnum Frangible HP - Available at Jaeger 1, This is a copper-tin frangible round intended for target practice without destroying steel target. Designed to mimic the flight path of similar hunting rounds, it should impact where expected. Like its closely related .50bmg round, it can dump all of immense energy in a single gel block.

Version 1.6.2 (& 1.6.3) Balancing Pass #2 Pistols

9x18mm PBP: changed short name, reduced penetration to 36, frag % reduced, added recoil, reduced accuracy, increased ricochet chance, bleed chances adjusted, armor damage reduced

7.62x25mm PBS: reduced damage, reduced pen, reduced armor damage, reduced ricochet chance, reduced accuracy, increased price

9x21mm 7N49: reduced damage, increased armor damage, increased ricochet chance, reduced accuracy, increased price, increased recoil

9x21mm FR gzh: Increased armor damage, increased frag chance, increased price, moved to Prapor 2

.50 AE Fr HP: Increased recoil, increased accuracy, ricochet to 0, increased armor damage, reduced pen

.50 AE Xtr: Increased recoil, increased bleed chance

.357 Xtr: Reduced damage by 1, increased recoil, increased armor damage, reduced bleed chance

4.6x30mm FR SX: Reduced pen by 1, increased armor damage, increased frag chance, increase ricochet chance, reduced bleed chances, reduced ballistic coefficient, increase price, move to Mechanic 2

4.6x30mm AP GX: Reduced frag chance, increase ricochet chance, bleed chance changes, increased ballistic coefficient, increase price very slightly

5.7x28mm SS190 X: Price adjustment to match trend in other added ammos, increased heavy bleed chance, increase ricochet chance, reduce armor damage slightly

Version 1.6.3 Balancing Pass #3 Rifles

.366 TKM AP-ME: Reduced price considerably, increased recoil, bleed adjustments

.50 BMG FR: Price adjustment, increase frag chance, decrease armor damage, increase accuracy, increase recoil slightly

.50 BMG Raufoss: Price adjustment, increase recoil, bleed adjustments

6.8x51mm SIG HP: Price adjustment, increase frag chance

6.8x51mm SIG Hunt: Price adjustment, slightly increase recoil

6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid BT: Price adjustment, reduced frag chance, reduced accuracy, bleed adjustments

.300 blk Punisher: Price adjustment, Moved to Peace keeper 2, increase frag chance, reduce ricochet chance

Version 1.6.1 Balancing Pass

Revised and refined all armor damage percentages. I slightly misunderstood what the values represented, some were too high, some too low. Should be more progressive throughout.

Major niche change to Steel Fragmentation Slug. This shell had its penetration and damage reduced slightly, recoil was increased, and it has been made much less accurate. Additionally, heat production went down, but durability burn went up. Lastly its price was slightly reduced to 429 Rb. The previous version was something I made some time ago, and really enjoyed it. However, I realized that its pen of 31 and high damage made it kinda fill the same role as the AP-21 Frag slug, expect you get the Steel slug at Mech 2 instead of Mech 3 for AP-21. So, now it has a much more niche role of almost a breaching slug. Its inaccuracy makes it a terrible choice for head popping, but is lower heat gen, good pen, and high damage make it a good choice for mid game close-mid range slug fests. Tried it in a few raids today and was having a lot of fun. Still expensive, but it is a 28 pen high damage slug after all. Other armor penetrating slugs will perform better, but this has a nice close in role now.

Changes to penetration of all 3.5 inch magnum shotgun shells. Also changes to certain recoil and accuracy stats. General mixed balancing of a few others.

Version 1.6.0 Restricted Ammunition

I have been toying around with creating shells and bullets that can only be used in specific weapons or categories of weapons. It took some time and effort, but I think I have done it. These certainly need testing, so let me know if something is off.

I did two categories to start off. First is pump shotgun shells, and second is high penetration bolt action rifle rounds. (Arena ammo, lets be real here)

Some final General notes on these: Bring a sidearm. Seriously. These are incredibly high powered and pressured ammos. They are not intended for extended combat, but rather niche burst damage. I believe I restricted most weapons you can use these in, but there might be a way to sneak a shell or round into a semi auto or god forbid an auto weapon. PLEASE DONT. not only is that kinda immersion breaking, it will be a bad time. I set the durability burn to be very high, these are crazy rounds. BUT, I also set the heat generation to be truly absurd. The low heat generation and cyclic rate of pump actions and bolt actions means that in those systems, the heat really isn’t a problem. But in a semiauto, good luck getting through a single mag or a tube and a half of shells. If this ends up being over tuned, let me know. But the whole point is to limit these to pumps and bolts.

3 ½ inch magnum Shotgun Shells:

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum T Steel Birdshot - This shell fires 71 steel T birdshot pellets at 1550 fps. The additional pellets and powder of this magnum loading mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged. While range is better than other birdshot loads, it is still something to consider during engagements.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum 00 Buckshot - This shell fires 18 00 buckshot pellets at 1100 fps. Each pellet is copper plated for added penetration and chance of fragmentation. The additional pellets and powder of this magnum loading mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum Rifled Slug - This shell fires a 600 grain (1 3/8 oz) lead slug at a staggering 1890 fps. Total muzzle energy is over 4700 ft/lbs, a true shoulder muncher. The additional power of this magnum load mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum .50 BMG Slug - This shell fires a 665 grain .50 BMG projectile pulled from a HP round that failed to fire. The round travels at 1750 fps, making the total muzzle energy over 4800 ft/lbs. The additional power of this magnum load mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

12/70 Federal 3 1/2 Inch Magnum “AP-35” - This shell fires the AP-20 projectile pulled from a round that failed to fire. The round travels at an incredible 2250 fps, making the total muzzle energy over 4900 ft/lbs. Made by Mechanic as an upgrade to the standard AP-20 shell, this brutal load is intended for only the sturdiest of shotguns, and shoulders. The additional power of this magnum load mean that durability should be watched closely, and rapid fire is strongly discouraged.

I will note, that with this update I think I am essentially done with Shotgun ammo creation. If there is something you think I missed out on, let me know. Otherwise, new shotgun shells will be rare. I will continue to balance and refine as I do my own lvl 0-75 run using shotguns as much as possible.

Bolt Action Rounds (Arena with restrictions):

7.62x51mm Ball 11 Long Range - Copy-pasta of the Arena Ammo, restricted to bolt actions.

7.62x54mm R Tungsten Carbide AP - Copy-pasta of the Arena Ammo, restricted to bolt actions.

Version 1.5.0 The great shotgun balancing act

So a little explanation first; BSG shotgun shells are so oddly balanced and make very little sense to me. Pretty much every shell has 8 or 9 pellets, with negligible difference in performance to the degree that pretty much there are two viable options, 5.25mm and Magnum buck. 6.5mm is also an option, but a single pellet cannot headshot, to me that greatly limits its usefulness when 5.25mm can headshot for quite a distance and is cheaper. Also, 7mm is just awful. It should perform only second to magnum, but is by far and above the worst option. The ballistic coefficient is needlessly terrible, and for some reason they gave each pellet ( which is the same size as #2 buckshot btw) the same weight as #7 birdshot. I have no words. So rant over, what did I do?

I standardized, balanced, and diversified the shotgun ammo choices. I pretty much remade every base EFT shell into a real world (mostly) example that is balanced and fun. Here we go: Added: 12/70 Federal Force X2 Fragmenting 00 Buckshot - a copper-antimony alloy with a lead interior. Each pellet features a deep cut with striations that open the pellet up upon contact with a soft target. The resulting expansion is rapid and destructive.

12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot - The 12/70 Federal Speed-Shok #2 Birdshot shell fires 141 #2 lead birdshot pellets at 1500 fps. Each pellet weighs 4.38 grains (0.28g) and is 3.81mm in diameter. These Shells are mainly for hunting, however have found their way into the shotguns of tarkov out of necessity.

12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck - The 12/70 Federal Shoulder-Shok 00000 Super Buck shell is the result of backcountry tinkering with shotgun shell loads. Four .490 musket balls can, just barely, fit inside a 12/70 shell with a little wadding. The result is a heavy shell with four large “buckshot” pellets. (Not a real Federal shell, Named Federal for Organization of Shells in Flea)

12/70 TSS AP Flechette - The 12/70 TSS AP Flechette Shell fires 15 tightly packed Tungsten-Steel Alloy penetrators at supersonic speeds. The result is a more penetrating and accurate shell over the standard Flechette.

12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug - The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug is a 547 grain pure lead semi-hollowpoint slug meant for hunting and general shooting. It has a good deal of kick, but is relatively cheap and effective.

12/70 Federal Power-Shok Rifled Slug - The 12/70 Federal Power-Shok Heavy Slug is a 438 grain (1 oz) pure lead Round nose slug meant for cheap target practice. It has less kick than its heavier cousin. Reliable, low impact on the gun, effective, and cheap.

12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slug - The 12/70 Federal LE BallistiClean Slug is a 325 grain copper-tin-lead frangible round intended for practice, door breaching, and rare field use. Its compressed powdered metal construction means that impact with a hard surface virtually disintegrates.

12/70 Federal Double Slug - The 12/70 Federal Double Slug is a pair of 382 grain copper plated lead slugs. When both hit, the total weight of lead is greater than 12 pellet 00 buckshot shells.

Renamed a few shells to make it easier to find in game. This will not break saves or lose items, 24 character identifier remains the same.

Rebalanced all shotgun shells, see charts on Github. There is now a clean and consistent progression of shells with each shell having a distinct and unique niche. Pretty much all base game shells have been replaced with a more balanced (to me) version. Make no doubt, shotguns are more effective with these shells, but an m4 or even AK is still the better pick. The difference being that if you are in close quarters, shotguns should actually be the threat they are in real life.

Version 1.4.0 Lots more shotgun shells! I standardized the shotgun shells for balance and purpose. Added: Federal Speed-Shok BB Birdshot - The shell fires 81 BB lead birdshot pellets at 1500 fps. Each pellet weighs 54 grains (3.49g) and is 6762mm in diameter.

Federal Power-Shock #4 Buckshot - The shell fires 27 #4 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 21 grains (1.33g) and is 6.1mm in diameter. These Shells are ideal for close range against no armor.

Federal Power-Shock #1 Buckshot - The shell fires 16 #1 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 41 grains (2.62g) and is 6762mm in diameter.

Federal Power-Shock 00 Buckshot - The shell fires 9 00 lead buckshot pellets at 1325 fps. Each pellet weighs 41 grains (3.49g) and is 8.38mm in diameter.

Federal Freight Train Copper Sabot Slug - a hunting sabot slug. It features a streamlined copper projectile and sabot design that can print groups of less than 4 inches at 200 yards. A polymer tip and aerodynamic nose profile maximize downrange energy, while the nose cavity provides dramatic expansion upon impact. 1900 fps, 300 grain, lots of power.

Steel Fragmentation Slug - a discarding Sabot 32 Gram Steel Fragmentation Slug sold by Firequest. The whole Slug travels at 1,500 fps and on contact, the center slug releases 6 razor sharp steel petals. The steel center core continues to penetrate deep into soft targets, while the petals flower out and enhance the wound channels. It is less accurate however, but does have less recoil.

Minor changes: Changed names of 00 and 000 buck shells, changed stats to match new Federal Power shock shells. They are all now actual shells from real life.

Fixed a few more weird stats. Seems like sometimes they switch from 0.75 to 75, and similar stuff. Might just be me mistyping, but if you see this let me know. Balancing of shotgun shell availability. Adjustments to spawning.

Version 1.3 Added: 40x46 M576-T (APERS-T) - A 40mm APERS canister that fires flechettes instead of buckshot. This was real, and the MK-19 grenade launcher can fire a version of them to this day.

40x46mm M406 RD - a 40x46mm M406 with a reduced arming fuse. Neat! I made a craft so you can make any 406 a useable one.

40mm VOG-25 RD - A 40mm VOG-25 with a reduced arming fuse. Neat! I made a craft so you can make any VOG-25 a useable one.

Grenades: Added: VOG 21 Disruption Grenade - Has the same body as the standard VOG-17, but with some of the explosive power being traded for a small flash grenade. The result is a grenade that will disrupt the enemy through direct damage if within the blast radius, or by stunning them with the flash and sound. Can plant this one too.

M4311: Added ability to plant on ground, have fun.

Minor changes: Fixed 7.62x25mm PBS having odd stats

Version 1.2

9x21mm FR gzh: A leg meta special feature. High flesh damage, virtually no pen. However, the extra powder needed to propel the bullet fasted for more hydrostatic shock means more heat. A good bit more.

4.6x30mm FRANG SX: Another leg meta gift. Basically I just made a 4.6 version of the 5.7x28mm R37 F. This is a high damage, low pen round for early game and high RoF guns.

KS-23: The KS-23 shells may be the most difficult shells I have made yet. At first I went into this thinking they would be easy, Big Soviet Gun Stronk Comrade. But I quickly learned how wrong peoples perception of this gun and similar guns is. This is not a crazy soviet era 23mm super shotgun. Its a utilitarian multitool for police and specialty military units. It usually uses stun rounds, gas grenade rounds, and the flash bang. The slug is used purely to stop cars and shoot through light barricades. The shrapnel shells were almost afterthoughts. Hell, the Shrapnel 25 is pretty much a 2 ¾ inch standard 00 buckshot round adapted to fit in the 23mm shell. The system is so low pressure, it really cant push the shells at any real velocity. Honestly, the in game rounds are too powerful for the real deal. The civilian market created much better and more effective shells. Quick note: most civilian shells were for the TOS-123, which was actually a smoothbore 26mm gun! I think they basically bored out the rifled AA 23mm barrels to make them. Most sources, of which there are few btw, estimate the civilian shells to be about on par with a 10 gauge to possible a 10 gauge magnum in power and capacity. So the three shells I added are pretty much in line with those, except I slightly reduced the velocity. Again, the KS-23 was quite low pressure, getting 1.5-2 ounce payloads to 1400 fps is gonna grenade the thing. For reference, here is a picture f the cross sections for the rounds. https://imgur.com/rgh2Xr7

23x75 “Shrapnel 5” Buckshot: Reload a used KS-23 shell with #4 buckshot and you have this shell. 54 pellets of #4 buck flung at barely supersonic speeds. Fun times.

23x75 Steel Birdshot: 144 pellets of BB birdshot at roughly the speed of sound is a recipe for a bad time on the receiving end. Will for sure cause a whole heap of bleeds assuming they survive the first shot. Super wide spread, very short range.

23x74mm Lead Slug: The civilian smoothbore versions rarely used slugs, but when they did it was a big ass hunk of lead launched as fast as possible. Believe it or not the Barrakada slug the military used was actually only about a .50 cal sized bullet at 500 grains. .50 BMG is a much better engine stopper. But the barakada basically can’t over penetrate, where as .50 BMG and the russian equivalent absolutely would. Thus, a 2 ounce lead slug (875 grains) being much heavier than 500, this is going to go slower. Another interesting thing, BSG coded the Barakada to be 80 grams, or over 1200 grains. That is just absurd. The Ks-23 would never handle shooting that at 420 m/s.

Minor changes: AP-21: Reduced price, moved to Peacekeeper 3, reduced pen, increased damage, increased bleeding, increased accuracy, reduced armor damage, reduced speed slightly, greatly increased recoil and heat/dura burn. Now fulfills a slightly earlier game niche. Revised description. Price and minor stat adjustments.

Version 1.1.1 Version 1.1.0 was a failed attempt to properly upload this to github. I’m still learning 4.6, 5.6. SIG, .300 blackout, .357, and .50 AE

I know, its a good few SIG, aka 6.8x51mm. This might be a surprising one, but the base game has 2 rounds for it. 2. Even .357 got like 5. I added three new cartridges to round out the tier 1-4 and light keeper progression. Now if you find a SPEAR at level 3 you can buy ammo for it!

6.8x51mm SIG HP - Available at peacekeeper 1, this high flesh damage low pen ammo is perfect for early game. Plus with the high ROF of the SPEAR, it can even be useful late game if your short on cash but just happen to have a spear on hand. Also its funny.

6.8x51mm SIG Brass Hunter - Available at peacekeeper level 2, this lower pen ammo allows low level players to use the spear and still do well.

6.8x51 SIG Hybrid Black Tip - OH yeah, M993 at home. This is a late game ammo, only available in raid or through lightkeeper in any reasonable quantity. Peacekeeper sells a very small quantity at a huge markup. Not much else to say.

.300 Blackout Punisher - Based on a real life frangible copper ammo, this nasty little devil breaks in to 3 leaves and a center base upon impact. Look up the wound cavities, definitely a war crime. But this is Tarkov! Roast those shins! .357 Magnum Copper penetrator - Xtreme penetrator. Better pen than fmj, less damage, no fragmentation chance. Pretty simple. Can black arms at close range, but not legs. Should make the chiappa and especially the .357 deagle more appealing to use early to mid game.

.50 AE Frangible Hollowpoint - A copper tin hybrid HP designed to dump its energy as fast as possible. Lots of bleeding chance. Pretty much no armor pen. Very useful if you dump a few rounds downrange and retreat, as the target will certainly have one or two light bleeds and probably a heavy one too. Up close, dump a mag into their pelvis and they will crumple over.

.50 AE Xtreme Penetrator - Yup, here we go again. This one offers marginally better pen over FMJ, but losses some of the important 1 shot potential. Can no longer 1 tap the chest, but can black the stomach at close range. Useful to ensure helmet pens, or reliably 2 tap the thorax. And of course the butt clinching mag dumps will be quite effective.

4.6x28mm AP GX - Take a small piece of tungsten, add it to the rear to increase weight and likelihood of tumbling. Sounds like something Mechanic would do right? Oddly enough this is a downgrade over the top tier ammo. This on has less pen, but more damage. This fills a niche roll that 4.6 left open. AP SX has a hilarious pen of 53, but damage is exactly 35. Meaning any range or any damage reduction from armor pen, and you can no longer 1 tap the head. AP GX has 49 pen, and 39 damage. So it has a much longer 1 tap range. This makes for a cool synergy where the worse pen ammo gets front loaded in the mag to get reliable 1 taps, but the higher pen stuff goes after to shred the giga chads. I really like this one, let me know what you think.

5.7x30mm SS90 - Your read that right, SS90. This was the original round HK intended to use. It was a super long and light round moving at stupid speed. 23 grains (1.5 grams) at 880 m/s. Silly stuff. But it just didn’t do well in penetration. I added this round as a rare find. It doesn’t really fill a niche, but i think its a cool piece or firearm history/lore.

5.7x30mm SS190 X - Put a small tungsten penetrator cap and a little extra powder behind it and you gain some AP SX pen, with AP GX damage. The downside is much higher durability burn and heating generation. So a full mag of this stuff will fold you durability and might even jam on the 1st mag. But if you top load it for a few, and then put normal 190, you get a nice combo. Expensive, and rare. Very rare.

Minor changes: Not gonna get too specific Balance adjustments, version 1.0.0 stuff should be more in line with base game Prices changes all around Heat adjustments A couple pen changes .50 BMG Fr got some added bleed Lightkeeper fix, it should work now? Crafting changes for a few rounds Fragmentation fixes after learning of the 20 frag bug, hopefully it works
Initial Release.

addons.name: Realism medical tweak
addons.teaser: Intends to add a practical use for unpopular items along with much more
addons.description_html:
What started as some personal quality of life changes and general curiosity, eventually turned into a complete overhaul of how consumable medical items are handled in 3.11.4 Realism.

Disclaimer: Some of these changes take a more “arcadey” approach in my attempts to make the more unpopular medical items have some sort of use for MYSELF inside of the game.

More of the medical items now heal you in more indirect ways now too. This is one of the QOL changes that I enjoy a lot but can imagine is not another person’s cup of tea. More on this in detail later.

Changes to pills

  • Analgin metamizole tablets is now a combination of adrenergic drugs to provide a prolonged buff to stamina and focus, at the price of gradually dumping your hydration.

  • Ibuprofen has been replaced by his steroid abusing coworker: Fentanyl. Similar in efficacy as the original Realisms Morphine injector, with very strong pain relief, but suffering from severe side effects as a result.

  • Augmentin is still the clutch antidote we all love, but it also now serves a dual function in blunting certain drug side effects that you intend to curb.

AI-2’s are still the easiest to obtain option for handling any radiation or toxins you might accumulate that will now heal a small portion of health with it as well. Also, you only have one charge per medkit, so I hope you like cheese…. along with other changes.

Surgery kits have gotten big buffs too, Surv Kit now has 20 charges and CMS will have 12. Pure quality of life, with no catch.

Injectors have had big changes made to them as well. It would take too long to go over them all, but I can share a few.

  • L1 Norepinephrine will now rapidly regenerate all lost stamina over 7 seconds along with its usual buffs.

  • Zagustin will now DUMP all of your current leg stamina for 25 seconds making you unable to sprint for the duration. Only stops bleeds for 15 seconds now, not 150 seconds.

  • Propital was too much of a clean stim for being so easily accessible, so it got nerfed for other healing stims to compete.

About Healing

Healing has been given to additional items. Here is a breakdown for the non stimulants.

  • Ai-2: Delay 35s, 3.5hp for 10s
  • Fentanyl lozenge (Ibuprofen): No Delay, 1hp for 60s
  • Augmentin: 80% Chance, Delay 65s, 1.2hp for 10s
  • Modafanil (Analgin): 25% Chance, Delay 300s, 0.15 hp for 300s
